title: Lemon
body:
"Lemons are sour citrus fruits with yellow skin and acidic juice."

Description

The Lemon is a item that can be found on Acacia (Ferwater Island) trees.

It may be sold to Jer Junkman for $250 per Lemon. In its jam form it may be sold for $600.

Gives a small speed boost when eaten.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~1.44% per lemon.
